name: Under the Golden Gate Bridge
where: Mid span, bound out to sea
teaches: Leaving. Out past Point Bonita, over the bar by the ship channel, and on to the sea buoy where the lightship lay. Go out on the ebb and mind the ships.

name: Off Point Bonita
where: Outside the north head, under the lighthouse
teaches: The inshore way north: the Bonita Channel between the Marin shore and the Potato Patch, then round Duxbury Reef to Bolinas.

name: Drakes Bay
where: At anchor inside Chimney Rock, in the lee of Point Reyes
teaches: A harbour of refuge and a headland. Out round Chimney Rock and west to Point Reyes, the windiest point on the coast, and back to shelter.

name: Bodega Harbour
where: Off the harbour jetties, in Bodega Bay
teaches: Pilotage. In between the jetties and up the dredged channel to the fishing town, with mud flats close on both sides.

name: Off Pacifica
where: A mile off the pier, on the open coast south of the Gate
teaches: A coastal passage with nowhere to hide: south past Point San Pedro and Montara to the breakwaters of Pillar Point.

name: The Farallon Islands
where: A mile east of Southeast Farallon, 27 miles out
teaches: Being a long way from anywhere. Round the island outside the refuge line: birds, sea lions, a lighthouse on a rock, and the ships' western lane to the south.
